subject: Re: Inquiry About Registration Fee and Submission Deadline
body:
Dear John Smith,

Thank you for your interest in ICCBDA 2027. We can confirm that the registration fee for student authors is USD 350. The full paper submission deadline is February 15, 2027.

For any additional information, please contact the conference secretariat at iccbda2027@example.org.

Best regards,
ICCBDA 2027 Conference Secretariat
